name: ai-policy-runtime
description: Generate better AI code with task-aware policies for Codex and Claude Code.

commands.title: AI Policy Runtime: Enable Post-Task Refinement
AI Policy Runtime: Show Effective Rules

aiPolicy.enabled.description: Enable AI Policy Runtime agent hooks for this workspace.

aiPolicy.agents.description: AI coding agents that should use this workspace policy configuration.

aiPolicy.packs.description: Policy packs to activate for agent prompts.

aiPolicy.policyRoot.description: Optional policy asset root. Leave empty to use the runtime bundled with this extension.

aiPolicy.autoInstall.description: Install missing Python dependencies automatically when agent hooks run.

enumDescriptions: Automatically choose the best configured semantic provider.
aiPolicy.embeddingProvider.description: Semantic embedding provider for task analysis.

aiPolicy.embeddingBaseUrl.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible embeddings base URL, such as https://api.openai.com/v1.

aiPolicy.embeddingApiKey.description: Optional API key for the OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint. Leave empty to use OPENAI_API_KEY.

aiPolicy.embeddingModel.description: Optional embedding model. Defaults to text-embedding-3-small for OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

aiPolicy.embeddingLocalModel.description: Local sentence-transformers model path or model name.

aiPolicy.embeddingTimeout.description: Optional embedding request timeout in seconds.

enumDescriptions: Follow explicit project tooling or recent history; otherwise use concise imperative subjects.
Use Conventional Commits type(scope): subject for Git commit tasks.
Use concise imperative commit subjects without forcing Conventional Commit type prefixes.
aiPolicy.gitCommitStyle.description: Git commit message style used by AI Policy Runtime when resolving Git workflow tasks.

enumDescriptions: Do not ask supported agents to continue with a refinement pass.
Ask for a light review-oriented refinement continuation.
Ask a supported agent to continue once with a production refinement pass.
Ask a supported agent to continue once with a stricter release-quality refinement pass.

aiPolicy.postRefinePacks.description: Policy packs added for the agent post-task refinement continuation.

aiPolicy.verifyTarget.description: Optional file, directory, or target the post-refinement pass should verify before ending.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run prepare-runtime && npm run compile
